liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): The jam transitioning from Truckin' to Wharf Rat is described as pure magic; The transition from Truckin' into the Weather Report suite is called indescribably perfect [5][14]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River is characterized as a driving performance that rips through the second set [6]
- **Weather Report Suite Prelude** (1 review): The listener hears a Darkness theme emerging around the three-minute forty-second mark [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-26.sbd.miller.34787.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 31 songs; 235 min; rated 4.82/5 by 28 [1]. Said about its sound: Reel flips are present in Here Comes Sunshine, the Truckin' jam, and Morning Dew [1]
- **gd1973-03-26.170436.sbd-set2patched.miller.lamarre.andrewf.vernon.flegel.flac1644**: soundboard; 16 songs; 125 min [2]
- **gd1973-03-26.170348.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac2496**: audience recording; 7 songs; 81 min [3]
- **gd1973-03-26.170347.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac1648**: audience recording; 7 songs; 81 min [4]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Wolfman Jack [1]
- Wolfman Jack appeared on stage, marking a moment of commercial influence for the band [6]
- Crowd members lit matches when Wolfman Jack asked, and Jerry referenced him during Ramble On Rose [12]
- Spring 1973 shows like this are argued to be as good as the hyped fall shows [7]
- The reviewer compares this show favorably to the May 26 Kezar Stadium performance [9]
- Spring 1973 shows are argued to be overlooked compared to the more hyped fall tours [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-26.sbd.miller.34787.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) D [1]. Also: The recording is noted as being as good as a 1973 board Miller transfer gets; The audio is described as a stereo hi-fidelity recording with a five-star transfer quality; Steve Rolfe provided the DAT source, and disc changes are noted as seamless [1][7][8]
- **gd1973-03-26.170436.sbd-set2patched.miller.lamarre.andrewf.vernon.flegel.flac1644**: source: Patched set 2 soundboard [2]. Also: Maxell tape was transferred via Nak CR-7A and Tascam DA-3000 to 24/96 PCM; Doug Lamarre, Andrew F, Matt Vernon, and Steve Flegel contributed to the patched source [2]
- **gd1973-03-26.170348.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac2496**: source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation/taper Medium Stock Brands: Maxell Epitaxial XLII-90 (70 uS EQ) Dolby Not specified Tape provided by Doug… [3]
- **gd1973-03-26.170347.aud.lamarre.vernon.AndrewF.flac1648**: source: Analog Audience Source: Unknown mic/deck/generation/taper Medium Stock Brands: Maxell Epitaxial XLII-90 (70 uS EQ) Dolby Not specified Tape provided by Doug… [4]
